category_edits.rationale: Broaden causal recency pooling from decay scale 4 to 8 for all four category models, testing whether longer context better preserves persistent interests. Retain the 0.75 state / 0.25 pooled readout and padding-aware causal normalization. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so inference automatically uses the same change without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Increase the shared HSTU causal recency-pooling decay scale from 4 to 8 during training and prediction; preserve all other settings.
